lines.speaker: gerrard
lines.text: Shh!  Don't worry, I'm no friend of the bandits.

lines.speaker: leora
lines.text: Neither are we.  We're planning a rescue.

lines.speaker: gerrard
lines.text: As am I.  My daughter was kidnapped by them just recently.

lines.speaker: gerrard
lines.text: I see.  Perhaps we should join forces?

lines.speaker: leora
lines.text: I'll take any help I can get to keep him alive.
